thread:
maria_support: Customer 'AcmeSales' upgraded to Pro (embeddings add-on) via Console yesterday evening, then immediately started getting 403s on embeddings endpoint. Customer says console shows "Pro - Embeddings" and invoice charged.

maria_support: Request sample they pasted: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"foo"}'
```
Response: `{\"error\":\"request unauthorized\", \"code\":403}`. Customer thinks it's an API key issue.

trevor_backend: I pulled entitlement logs for tenant=acme-sales around that time. Looks like billing webhook arrived but tenant plan in our cache was still "starter" when the request hit the entitlement check. Snippet from entitlement-service logs: 
```
[2025-11-12T22:14:03Z] tenant=acme-sales check=embeddings.vector result=DENIED reason=plan_missing
[2025-11-12T22:14:03Z] tenant=acme-sales plan_cached=starter billing_updated_at=2025-11-12T22:12:58Z
```
That explains denies even though invoice exists.

maria_support: customer insists console showed Pro as of 22:13, billing timestamp 22:12. They created a new API key after upgrade and still 403s.

sam_product: Product note: our billing -> control-plane webhook can be processed out-of-order with the plan-sync cache refresh under load. We shouldn't surface this as "invalid key" to customers. Suggestion: return 403 but include diagnostic header `X-Entitlement-Flow: pending-sync` and a user-facing message like "Plan update pending — retry in a few minutes or contact support". Also file follow-up to make the sync idempotent/strongly-consistent.

lee_devex: Short-term mitigation: we have an internal endpoint to force tenant sync. Can you run: 
```
POST https://control.internal/v1/tenants/acme-sales/sync
Authorization: Bearer internal-REDACTED
```
Then re-run the customer's call. For repro: create a test tenant, simulate webhook with billing timestamp T, then hammer requests to embeddings to see the race. I can write a small script.

maria_support: I triggered the internal sync for acme-sales at 22:16:30. Customer retried and the embedding call returned 200. They thanked us but asked why UI showed Pro before calls passed.

trevor_backend: Root cause summary: billing webhook processed, but cache TTL + eventual consistency in plan cache produced a short window where entitlement check still used old plan. We return generic 403 which looks like auth failure. Action items: (1) change error surface to be more specific + header (sam), (2) add quick-sync on plan change events with retry/backoff (eng), (3) monitor rate of these races (sre).

sam_product: I'll add the header and tweak user message. For long-term, we'll make the billing->control-plane handshake synchronous for plan activation or at least block API key creation until plan activation confirmed.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: tenant-sync job executed for acme-sales (job_id=sync-1723) at 2025-11-12T22:16:31Z :white_check_mark:

maria_support: Logged the customer case and sent a note explaining the race and that we manually synced their tenant. Customer accepted explanation. Marking as resolved for now, will follow up once product changes are in. :thumbsup:

lee_devex: I'll send a repro script and a small automation to trigger sync on customer-initiated key creation in the meantime.

trevor_backend: +1 to metrics. I'll add a datapoint that tracks (billing_event_time vs plan_cache_effective_time) and alert if >1s tail.

sam_product: Creating product ticket and linking this thread.

maria_support: closing thread, will re-open if customer sees recurrence.
